propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table has incomplete coverage: claude-opus-4-8 (rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL) and both global.* prefix variants of opus models are unguarded despite rejecting explicit non-default temperature values.

Temperature parameter is rejected (400 ValidationException) on opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 across both us. and global. prefixes when set to 0.0 or 0.5, but succeeds at the API default (temp=1.0), indicating parameter tunability is deprecated rather than the parameter itself being unsupported.

The defect affects both Bedrock and direct Anthropic paths: Bedrock adapter 400s on temperature, while Anthropic adapter (pydantic-ai) silently drops the parameter with a warning, causing Pass-2 code-review determinism assumption (temperature=0 pin) to fail silently in production.

The override table must cover bare ids (claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7) for Anthropic path and prefixed ids (us./global. variants) for Bedrock path, or use family-portion matching to avoid per-id duplication.
Top_p parameter is also deprecated on opus models (confirmed in CloudTrail logs) but lacks a supports_top_p capability guard, creating a latent defect for when rebar sends this parameter.
